name: Flour
description: Flour cloud POS and merchandise management (Germany), read-only: articles with prices and stock per warehouse, stock movements, receipts, invoices and other documents, sold articles per period and till, business partners, cash register journals, stocktakes, branches and points of sale.
instructions:
## Flour
This connector reads **Flour** (flour.io), the German cloud POS and merchandise management system (Kasse, Warenwirtschaft, Rechnungen), through its REST API v3: articles with prices and stock, stocks and stock movements, sales documents and receipts, sold articles per period, business partners, cash register journals, stocktakes, branches and points of sale. It is read-only.

**Setup**
1. Flour issues API tokens on request: write to developer@flour.io from the account owner's address and ask for a REST API v3 token for your Flour account.
2. Paste the token into `FLOUR_API_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.
3. Install and run `flour_list_stocks` to check the token.

**Workflow**
- Master data first: `flour_list_stocks` (stock ids), `flour_list_points_of_sale` (till ids for the sales filters), `flour_list_branches`.
- Sales: `flour_get_sold_articles` for quantity and revenue per article in a period (e.g. yesterday, last week, per till); `flour_list_documents` for the receipts and invoices themselves (type `R`), quotes `N`, orders `A`, delivery notes `L`, credit notes `G`, purchase invoices `r`, purchase orders `b`; `flour_get_document` for one document in full; `flour_list_pos_journals` for till openings and closings with cash amounts.
- Articles and stock: `flour_find_article` by article number or EAN, `flour_search_articles` with filters (e.g. `stock` + `stockOperator` `lte` + `stockAmount` 5 for low stock), `flour_get_article`, `flour_get_article_stock`, `flour_get_article_stock_availability`, `flour_list_article_stock_movements`. In an article, `stockAvailability` is keyed by stock id with `physical` (counted) and `calculated` (after open orders) amounts, plus the totals.
- Customers and suppliers: `flour_list_business_partners`. Stocktakes: `flour_list_inventories`, `flour_get_inventory`. Saved statistics: `flour_list_statistics`.

**Dates**: filters take ISO 8601 in UTC, e.g. `2026-10-21T22:00:00.000Z` for midnight on 22 October in Germany (UTC+2 in summer, UTC+1 in winter). For one German business day use the previous day at 22:00 or 23:00 UTC as `dateAfter`. Amounts are in the document currency (usually EUR); `totalExVat` is net, `totalIncVat` gross.

**Paging**: lists are plain arrays without a total; ask for the next `skip` while a page comes back full. Keep document ranges short on busy tills: a year of receipts is tens of thousands of documents. Answers over 400 KB are cut: narrow the range.

**Limits and errors**: Flour allows about 60 requests per minute per token (`429` above that; wait a minute). 401 means a wrong or revoked token: ask developer@flour.io. Credentials stored in Flour (payment terminals, fiscal TSE, bank accounts) are never passed on by this connector.
prerequisites: A Flour account and a REST API v3 token, which Flour issues on request at developer@flour.io.

FLOUR_API_TOKEN.label: API token
FLOUR_API_TOKEN.help: The REST API v3 token Flour issues on request: write to developer@flour.io from the account owner's address.
FLOUR_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without Bearer, spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Flour refused the token: it is wrong or was revoked. Ask developer@flour.io for a new REST API v3 token.
verifyHints.403: The token works, but it may not read this area. Ask developer@flour.io to extend it.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Flour allows about 60 requests per minute per token. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: flour_list_stocks
tools.description: List the stocks (warehouses, shop floors, online stock) with id, name and address. The id is what the stock filters take, and the key of each stock in an article's stock availability. Use it to check the connection.

transform.expression: [].{_id: _id, name: name, displayName: displayName, address: address, status: status}

tools.name: flour_list_branches
tools.description: List the branches (shops or locations) with id, name, address and opening hours for pickup. Fiscal and payment credentials of the branch are never returned.

transform.expression: [].{_id: _id, name: name, displayName: displayName, location: location, pickupHours: pickupHours, status: status}

tools.name: flour_list_points_of_sale
tools.description: List the points of sale (cash registers) with id, name, branch, default stock and mode. The id is what pointofsale takes in the document and sales tools. Payment terminal and fiscal settings are never returned.

transform.expression: [].{_id: _id, name: name, displayName: displayName, branch: branch, defaultstock: defaultstock, edition: edition, mode: mode, inUse: inUse, status: status}

tools.name: flour_search_articles
tools.description: Search articles (products): id, article number, title, EAN, manufacturer, sales prices per price list, purchase prices, stock per stock (physical and calculated) and reorder levels. Filter by number, EAN, code, tag, stock level or creation and update time. Results are a plain list without a total; page with skip.

inStock.description: true for articles with stock only.

outOfStock.description: true for articles without stock only.

stock.description: Stock id (flour_list_stocks) the stock filters apply to.

stockAmount.description: Stock level to compare with, e.g. 5 with stockOperator lte for low stock.

updatedAfter.description: Changed at or after. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

createdAfter.description: Created at or after. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

tools.name: flour_find_article
tools.description: Find articles by article number or EAN in one call (the barcode scanned at the till or printed on a label).

tools.name: flour_get_article
tools.description: Get one article with every field: prices per price list, purchase data, stock settings and availability, variants, bundle parts, allergens, custom attributes, tags and images.

tools.name: flour_get_article_stock
tools.description: Get the total stock of one article, physical (counted) and calculated (after open orders), across all stocks or in one stock.

tools.name: flour_get_article_stock_availability
tools.description: Get the stock availability of one article per stock, physical and calculated, optionally for a period.

from.description: Start. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

to.description: End. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

tools.name: flour_list_article_stock_movements
tools.description: List the stock movements (stock item entries) of one article in a period: goods received, sales, corrections, transfers, with amount and stock.

from.description: Start. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

to.description: End. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

tools.name: flour_list_documents
tools.description: List sales and purchase documents (receipts and invoices, quotes, orders, delivery notes, credit notes, purchase orders) in a date range: number, type, date, customer, point of sale, totals with and without VAT, VAT breakdown, payment status and the items (number, title, amount, price). Filter by type, point of sale, business partner or article. Keep the range short (a day or a week) on busy tills; page with skip.

type.description: Document type: N quote (Angebot), A order (Auftrag), L delivery note (Lieferschein), R invoice or receipt (Rechnung), r purchase invoice (Einkaufsrechnung), G credit note (Gutschrift), b purchase order (Bestellung).

dateAfter.description: Document date at or after. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

dateBefore.description: Document date at or before. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

article.description: Only documents containing this article id.

tools.name: flour_get_document
tools.description: Get one document with every field: items with prices, discounts and VAT, payments, billing and shipping address, point of sale and cash register data, status flags.

tools.name: flour_get_sold_articles
tools.description: Get the articles sold in a period (invoices and receipts minus credit notes), one row per article with quantity sold and revenue without VAT, plus article number, title, EAN and manufacturer. Optional per point of sale. The best tool for "what sold best this week"; sort the rows by amount or totalExVat yourself.

dateAfter.description: Start. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

dateBefore.description: End. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

pointofsale.description: Only this point of sale id.

transform.expression: [].{article: article, type: type, amount: amount, totalExVat: totalExVat, number: articleRef[0].number, title: articleRef[0].title, ean: articleRef[0].ean, manufacturer: articleRef[0].manufacturer}

tools.name: flour_list_business_partners
tools.description: List business partners (customers and suppliers): id, name, debtor and creditor number, addresses, contacts, discount, credit limit and tags. Bank details are never returned. Filter by e-mail, debtor or creditor number, or change time.

updatedAfter.description: Changed at or after. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

transform.expression: [].{_id: _id, displayName: displayName, type: type, isDebitor: isDebitor, debitorNumber: debitorNumber, isCreditor: isCreditor, creditorNumber: creditorNumber, billingAddress: billingAddress, shippingAddress: shippingAddress, contacts: contacts, discount: discount, creditLimit: creditLimit, pricelist: pricelist, tags: tags, notes: notes, updatedAt: updatedAt}

tools.name: flour_list_pos_journals
tools.description: List the cash register journals (one per opening and closing of a till): number, point of sale, opening and closing cash, withdrawals, when it was closed and by whom. Filter by closing or creation date.

closedAfter.description: Closed at or after. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

closedBefore.description: Closed at or before. ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (UTC; Germany is UTC+1 in winter, UTC+2 in summer).

transform.expression: [].{_id: _id, number: number, pointofsale: pointofsale, initialValue: initialValue, finalValue: finalValue, startDifference: startDifference, withdrawal: withdrawal, withdrawalTotal: withdrawalTotal, noCash: noCash, inUse: inUse, closed: closed, currency: currency, user: user, createdAt: createdAt, updatedAt: updatedAt}

tools.name: flour_list_inventories
tools.description: List the stocktakes (Inventuren) with id, name, creation date and closing date (null while still open). Read one with flour_get_inventory.

tools.name: flour_get_inventory
tools.description: Get one stocktake with its counted items (article number, title, EAN, counted amount, purchase price) and the totals.

tools.name: flour_list_statistics
tools.description: List the saved statistics of the account (each a key, e.g. a top-seller list, with its rows of article, amount and revenue).
